epic.title: Reduce CC (Cyclomatic Complexity) to ≤5 for 5 functions across 3 files in src2/.
deliverables: All functions pass uv run ruff check.

user_stories.story: As a developer I want agents.py logic flat and low-CC so I can easily reason about message assembly.
As a developer I want forecast_store.py logic flat and low-CC so trigger data synthesis is maintainable.
As a product owner I want promo code validation to have linear flow to avoid corner-case charging issues.

definition_of_done: Try/except blocks across all 3 files remain <= 2 total
acceptance_criteria: find_cc_nested.py reports 0 violations across the 3 scoped files.
uv run ruff check passes on all 3 files.
All existing unit tests pass without regression.

cells.criterion: All 5 target functions have a Cyclomatic Complexity <= 5 using find_cc_nested.py.
cells.evidence: find_cc_nested.py reports min-cc=6 yields 0 violations for scoped files.

cells.criterion: Refactored functions preserve correct data handling and data-table O(1) loopups.
cells.evidence: No try-except > 2 and zero dict dispatch usage in new implementations.

draft.summary: This workplan resolves 5 non-compliant Cyclomatic Complexity (CC) violations across agents.py, forecast_store.py, and billing.py within the src2/ codebase. 3 subtasks have been outlined to execute concurrency, leveraging AST-edit tools. The refactoring strategy utilises guard clauses, helper extraction, and structural pattern matching to flatten nesting while retaining functionality without raising Try/Except limits.

subtasks.title: Refactor agents.py CC Violations
subtasks.instruction: Refactor _format_advisory_value and _get_fallback_narrative to have CC <= 5. Extract helpers (e.g., _format_list_advisory, _format_dict_advisory) and use match/case instead of isinstance chains. Ensure no dict dispatch.
subtasks.acceptance: CC of _format_advisory_value and _get_fallback_narrative <= 5, tests pass, ruff passes.

evidence.content: _format_advisory_value and _get_fallback_narrative are the target functions to refactor.

subtasks.title: Refactor forecast_store.py CC Violations
subtasks.instruction: Refactor _synthesize_and_save_daily_forecast and _extract_trigger_labels to have CC <= 5. Extract a separate _extract_triggers_from_event helper function for the nested loops, and use guard clauses to handle None/empty cases early.
subtasks.acceptance: CC of _synthesize_and_save_daily_forecast and _extract_trigger_labels <= 5, tests pass, ruff passes.

evidence.content: _synthesize_and_save_daily_forecast and _extract_trigger_labels are target functions to refactor.

subtasks.title: Refactor billing.py CC Violations
subtasks.instruction: Refactor validate_promo_code to have CC <= 5. Apply early returns and simple guard clauses instead of nested if-else structures.
subtasks.acceptance: CC of validate_promo_code <= 5, tests pass, ruff passes.

evidence.content: validate_promo_code is the target function to refactor.

risks: Breaking existing functionality while refactoring deeply nested logic.
Introducing new unit test failures if helper functions are not properly scoped or parameterised.
Accidentally increasing total try/except block counts across files.

strategy.how_to_fix: Apply early returns and guard clauses to linearise execution. Extract functional blocks within deeply nested iterations (such as the dict/list recursive processing in _format_advisory_value) into module-level private helpers prefixed with `_`. Substitute instance type-checking chains (`isinstance...`) with python `match/case` structural pattern matching where possible.
